name: @e2e-dev/web-benchmark
description: Benchmark app of hard web surfaces, with the e2e suites written against them

scripts.test: pnpm run build && node node_modules/e2e/dist/cli/bin.js run
scripts.test:headed: pnpm run build && node node_modules/e2e/dist/cli/bin.js run --headed
scripts.test:agent: pnpm run build && node node_modules/e2e/dist/cli/bin.js run --config e2e.agent.config.ts
